verdict.rationale: GrowthBook provides documented Docker Compose self-hosting instructions covering the full stack (MongoDB, API, front-end), plus a self-host proxy for performance/resilience, and community evidence confirms real-world self-hosted deployments running happily for months. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the full self-hosted setup process beyond the HN anecdote, and no explicit confirmation that all premium features (e.g., SSO/SCIM) are available in self-hosted core vs cloud-only tiers.
